body_html:
The American Powerball jackpot has eclipsed a billion dollars! Lottery enthusiasts around the world are lining up their plays for this rare opportunity. Here’s everything you need to know about the big draw.

Wednesday’s Big Jackpot

The American Powerball Jackpot on Wednesday October 4 is an estimated $1.2 Billion!

The jackpot has not been won for two and a half months – the last jackpot win was awarded on July 19. Overall, the jackpot has rolled over 32x to get us to this point.

Understanding American Powerball

American Powerball is a multi-state lottery game that is played in 45 states, plus Washington D.C. and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The game is played by selecting five numbers from 1 to 69 and one Powerball number from 1 to 26. Draws take place three times per week – every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday.
